info.name: Get a paginated list of holdings

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of holdings to return

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of holdings to skip before collecting results

params.name: includeMetrics
params.description: Include financial metrics (IRR, TVPI, and DPI) in the response

params.name: includeOwnership
params.description: Include ownership info. Will cause an error if holding is not set up for lookthrough extraction. Provides the ownership percentage of the fund, and the issuing entity to query to access the underlying portfolio companies.

params.name: includeTransferInfo
params.description: Include transfer relationships (transferInfo) for each holding in the response. When omitted or false, the transferInfo field is not returned.

params.name: includeBlackDiamondInfo
params.description: Include Black Diamond info in the response

params.name: includeCustomFields
params.description: Set this to true to receive custom fields associated with the holding.

params.name: includeAddeparInfo
params.description: Include Addepar info in the response

params.name: includeArchwayInfo
params.description: Include Archway info in the response

params.name: includeBurgissInfo
params.description: Include Burgiss info in the response

params.name: includeTamaracInfo
params.description: Include Tamarac info in the response

params.name: includeOrionInfo
params.description: Include Orion info in the response

params.name: investingEntityIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the investing entity ids in the provided argument

params.name: issuingEntityIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the issuing entity ids in the provided argument

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the account ids in the provided argument

params.name: name
params.description: Filter the output for holding names that include the search term.

params.name: beforeEndDate
params.description: Filter the output for holdings with an end date before the queried date.

params.name: afterEndDate
params.description: Filter the output for holdings with an end date after the queried date.

params.name: beforeStartDate
params.description: Filter the output for holdings with a start date before the queried date.

params.name: afterStartDate
params.description: Filter the output for holdings with a start date after the queried date.

params.name: includeTax
params.description: Controls whether tax placeholder holdings are included in the results. Use "Only" to return only tax placeholder holdings, "Include" to include them along with regular holdings, or "Exclude" to exclude them entirely. Defaults to Exclude.

params.name: valueAsOfDate
params.description: Return financial values as of this date (YYYY-MM-DD). When omitted, the latest values are returned.

params.name: valueCalculationMethod
params.description: Controls how financial values are calculated. "statementsOnly" pulls the value directly from the latest statement before the "as of" date; "includeCashFlows" (the default) uses that account statement, plus/minus and subsequent cash flows up to the "as of" date.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of holdings

items.docs: Returns the data for a specific holding, if the user has access through the access token.

info.name: Add a new funds or real estate holding to Arch

items.docs: Creates a new funds or real estate holding (direct ownership) and returns the holding. Financial values should be provided in USD (currently the only supported currency). Values can be negative. No defaults are applied - values are stored exactly as provided. Note: offeringInfo should be null for Real Estate - Direct Ownership.

info.name: Add a new company holding to Arch

items.docs: Creates a new company holding (direct equity, SAFE, convertible note, etc.) and returns the holding. Financial values should be provided in USD (currently the only supported currency). Values can be negative. No defaults are applied - values are stored exactly as provided. Note: sharesInfo should be null for all except Company - Direct Equity. Note: offeringInfo should be null for all except Company - Direct Equity and Company - SAFE.

info.name: Add a new account holding to Arch

items.docs: Creates a new account holding (bank account, brokerage account, etc.) and returns the holding. Financial values should be provided in USD (currently the only supported currency). Values can be negative. No defaults are applied - values are stored exactly as provided.
